FontEffect(callbacks?) implements optional synchronous HasUniqueTexture, GetGlyphMetrics and GenerateGlyphTexture overrides. Six direct scenarios verify actual input origins, owned glyph snapshots, native scratch RGBA row isolation, safe metadata reentry, exact exception propagation, recursive/getter guards, promises, standalone closure GC/shutdown and destination transfer/resize rejection before writes. Package regression passes 41 runtime files with 349 PASS / 0 FAIL. Standalone ownership now also covers effect lists, Property snapshots, dictionary copies and nested declaration properties using private JS edges and iterative value traversal without changing effect/list pointer identity. Six value ownership cases verify retention, replacement, snapshot independence, collectable cycles and shutdown/restart; full regression passes 42 files, 355 PASS / 0 FAIL. Native ownership then covers parser/instancer handoff, element trees and attributes, stylesheet nodes/definitions/keyframes including inactive media and expired views, global/factory caches, property defaults, context roots (cursor proxy, drag clones, pending unloaded documents) and the default engine's non-owning live FontFaceLayer registry. Native state is snapshotted before V8 allocation; private edges retain reachable callbacks while cycles collect, and releaseFontResources drops font-layer roots. Nineteen native ownership cases include real RCSS green glyph pixels, atlas identity/reuse and font resource release; full regression passes 43 test files, 374 PASS / 0 FAIL. FontEffect customization is locally verified on macOS arm64.

FontEffect constructs the concrete native base and exposes metadata getters/setters and virtual GetGlyphMetrics/GenerateGlyphTexture. FontEffectList accepts effect arrays plus independent text; list/value writes allocate fresh const shared storage in the supplied order. Parsed derived effects keep native texture/metric behavior through a const-safe delegating effect; repeated edits flatten delegates. Colourb is unpremultiplied; fingerprint is exact size_t BigInt. Out vectors return as {supported,origin,dimensions}; destination RGBA view/stride bounds and source overlap are validated.

Writable DecoratorDeclaration/FilterDeclaration records; native list constructors accept records and independent text. Both DecoratorList/FilterList expose list/value setters. Typed DecoratorInstancer/FilterInstancer lookup tokens preserve native pointers, with kind and generation validation. Properties retain local IDs and full owned Property values; name is display metadata. Auto default paint area, null named decorator, exact UTF-8 text. List conversion explicitly rejects incomplete dictionaries, unknown local IDs, null filter instancers and invalid paint areas.

DecoratorList owns the native shared pointer; preserves null and pointer identity through Property/attribute/event conversion. Constructor parses RCSS; failed Property Get<T> returns typed null while attribute/event defaults retain fallback.

Assigning either copies the exact input view into native unique storage and selects it as bitmap_data; null clears the selection. FontGlyphMap is a typed Map<number,FontGlyph> using Unicode code-point keys. WeakCopy copies native metadata and shares the current bitmap allocation, with null bitmapOwnedData.
